milestone: Controlled cultural transmission and supported grammar first use
boundedGoalAcceptance: passed; seeded conventions, actor-first supported use and unrestricted invention explicitly distinguished

sweep.interpretation: Syntax-only symbolic experiment, no bodies, births, survival or audio fitness. Lexicon.child supplies weak inherited grammar; exact I/IS/HURT/WALK lexical priors are explicitly normalized to isolate syntax. Adaptive contact hears eight public injury examples per learner. Disconnected learners receive none; frozen learners receive no updates. Seeded compact source starts with authored SO/implicit-IS construction strength 9. Supported-first-use starts without constructions and deliberately exercises the engine's already-authored omission option, then rehearses the emitted form. This is actor-first use and diffusion of a supported pattern, not engine invention. Three staged cohorts per seed use the previous cohort's first learner as teacher; no selection for success. The held-out WALK meaning is never a lesson event. All seeds/conditions and failures are retained; no demographic or population-scale claim.

culture-result.json.fixture: NEW peaceful platform, four original stationary NoAI villagers. Source adult starts with full plains SVO and ZERO constructions. Three sparse learner/control lexicons use the actual child inheritance routine plus explicitly equal I/IS/HURT/WALK lexical priors to isolate syntax; no productive construction or parent memory is seeded. Source and bridge have one setup native injury each. A stone visibility barrier prevents target from observing source, while bridge can see both. Separate wall isolates the comparison. Controlled 200-tick opportunities deliberately exercise the already-authored IS-omission option through Speech.innovateObservedState. Bridge speaks only after its own grammar selects the learned form, then target learns from its actual relay utterances. Held-out WALK construction is generated/interpreted for evaluation, never taught as an event. This is supported first use and controlled diffusion, not spontaneous discovery of new syntax, actual births, natural maturation or survival. Only public-state Speech/learning paths run; no post-setup actor setters or new resources.

baseline.worldUsage: Read-only compiled classes, source archive, libraries and mods. Baseline world is never opened.
